# Holybro H-FLOW - highly inaccurate + drift

Hi all.

We have a drone that we are trying to fly in offboard mode using the Holybro H-Flow sensor with our custom flight controller.

We are having some issues with the accuracy of the flow sensor - I did a test flight where I was manually flying the drone North → West → South → East in a square - But the drone came out around 45 degrees offset with the flow sensor and with a large offset between take off and landing spot (IRL it was within 1-2 meters). The sensor it self is mounted 90 degrees rotated, and SENS\_FLOW\_ROT was set to 90 degrees (option 2). When we are flying, we also see the position drifting a lot.

There is a flight log available here:

### Describe the bug

I have a drone equipped with GPS and a Holybro H-Flow module, and I am ascending it at a constant rate to evaluate the performance of the distance sensor. I climb to approximately 30 meters and then analyze the Distance Sensor logs after the flight. Upon review, I observed that the sensor data is not accurate. It provides correct measurements up to a certain altitude, but beyond that, the data becomes static. (Note: The Holybro H-Flow documentation states that it supports up to 30 meters.) Additionally, when performing this test without an actual flight, I noticed that the distance sensor's update rate drops below 1 Hz after 10 meters.
